top_signals.title: Bank of America shares drop 8% after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
top_signals.summary: Bank of America shares fell Wednesday after the company posted weaker-than-expected trading revenue and the impact of a $1.2 billion Treasury fine.

top_signals.title: India Will Overhaul Examination System, Says Education Minister
top_signals.summary: As the Indian government addresses weaknesses exposed by exam leaks, education minister Pralhad Joshi says that they will revamp the examination system using technology. He spoke on a host of topics, as the minister of multiple portfolios, with Bloomberg's Yvonne Man. (Source: Bloomberg)
